description: Change how a Link in Bio page looks. `preset` applies a ready-made look; the colours fine-tune it (`page_background_mode: gradient` blends page_background_color into page_background_color_2). Only the fields sent change; null resets one to the default.

border_color.description: Hex colour like #1b5a8a; null resets to the default.

box_background_color.description: Hex colour like #1b5a8a; null resets to the default.

domain.description: Domain whose Link in Bio page this is, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

page_background_color.description: Hex colour like #1b5a8a; null resets to the default.

page_background_color_2.description: Hex colour like #1b5a8a; null resets to the default.

page_color.description: Hex colour like #1b5a8a; null resets to the default.

name: update_link_in_bio_appearance
title: Update Link In Bio Appearance
